summary: The claim is for preserving E-Rate funding to ensure budgetary stability for public education and libraries.

claims.argument: Terminating E-Rate would create severe budget shortfalls for public education and libraries
claims.evidence_quote: Terminating or significantly restricting E-Rate funding—such as limiting support only to rural areas or linking connectivity to unrelated screen-time rules—would create severe budget shortfalls for public education and public libraries.
